title: Chatbot Arena: An Open Platform for Evaluating LLMs by Human Preference
authors: W. Chiang, L. Zheng, Y. Sheng, et al.
before: Models were ranked on static benchmarks that leaked into training data.
problem: Benchmark scores stopped predicting which model people actually preferred.
breakthrough: Anonymous head-to-head comparisons from the public, aggregated into an Elo-style rating.
why: It became the field's de facto leaderboard, and exposed how weakly benchmark scores track usefulness.
next: Style controls and category breakdowns as the arena's own biases became apparent.
inherits: Human preference as the headline ranking, with all its noise.
